[Page 1]
UNIT 4 - AT THE AIRPORT. VOCABULARY
check-in desk (n): quầy làm thủ tục
boarding pass (n): thẻ lên máy bay
departure gate (n): cổng khởi hành
customs (n): hải quan
carry-on bag (n): hành lý xách tay
delayed (adj): bị hoãn
luggage cart (n): xe đẩy hành lý
Example: Please show your boarding pass at the departure gate.

[Page 2]
GRAMMAR - PAST SIMPLE
Affirmative: Subject + V2 (I missed my flight yesterday.)
Negative: Subject + did not (didn't) + V1 (She didn't buy a ticket.)
Question: Did + Subject + V1 ...? (Did you go to the airport by taxi?)
Irregular verbs: go - went | buy - bought | take - took | see - saw
Regular verbs: miss - missed | board - boarded | arrive - arrived

[Page 3]
DIALOGUE - AT THE CHECK-IN DESK
Agent: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket, please?
Passenger: Here you are. I booked a window seat.
Agent: Thank you. Did you pack your bags yourself?
Passenger: Yes, I did. I have one suitcase and one carry-on bag.
Agent: Your flight leaves from gate 12 at 9:30. Boarding starts at 9:00.
Passenger: Thanks a lot. Where is customs?

[Page 4]
READING - TOM'S TRIP
Tom arrived at the airport at 7 a.m. He went to the check-in desk and showed his passport. His flight to Singapore was delayed for two hours, so he bought a coffee and read a book. At 10 a.m. he boarded the plane.
Questions: 1) Where did Tom go? a) Japan b) Singapore c) France. 2) Why did he buy a coffee? a) He was hungry b) His flight was delayed c) He missed his flight.
EXERCISE A. Fill in the blanks with the Past Simple: She ___ (buy) a ticket. We ___ (go) to gate 5.
EXERCISE B. Put the words in order: flight / did / your / leave / when ?
